counterevidence_considered.description: A complemented panel series does exist in this workflow (panel_complement_values = 1 - value), which is the hallmark of the in-scope issue class, so I traced every use of it. It appears only in complement_selectors, which are summed into complement_agreement_count and reported solely as the quality-control line (value 6); it never enters agreement_count, agreement_rate, or confirmed_emission_kg. The report also states this scoping explicitly, and the stated scoping matches the code.
counterevidence_considered.observed_value: complement series confined to a QC count of 6; absent from the emission accumulation

source_refs.quoted_text: panel_complement_values = [1 - value for value in panel_values]

The complemented reference column is a quality-control artifact only; it never
enters the emission accumulation. Every value entering the emission accumulation
is the reference-panel value in the coding in which the staged file holds it.

evidence.description: The emission accumulation uses concordance_selectors (observed vs. panel as staged) and panel_values (the staged coding), not the complemented series; complement_selectors feed only a separately reported QC count.
evidence.observed_value: emission term = concordance_selector × staged panel value × flux

source_refs.quoted_text:
concordance_selectors = [equality_selector(observed_values[position], panel_values[position]) for position in unit_indices]
complement_selectors = [equality_selector(observed_values[position], panel_complement_values[position]) for position in unit_indices]

evidence.description: Independent recount from inputs/data.csv confirms every reported figure under the as-supplied coding: 6 discordant plots (P04, P06, P11, P14, P19, P23), 18/24 = 0.75 agreement, and the emission sum over the eleven plots with observed=1 and panel=1 (412+358+476+289+523+367+441+318+395+509+384) equals 4472 kg.
evidence.observed_value: 18 concordant, rate 0.75, emission 4472 kg CH4/yr — all reproduce under the staged coding

source_refs.quoted_text:
Total measured units (inventory plots): 24
Units whose observed call equals the staged reference-panel call: 18
Units whose observed call differs from the staged reference-panel call: 6
Per-unit agreement rate used by the emission accumulation: 0.75
Quality-control complement check, units whose observed call equals the complemented reference value: 6
Accumulated emission, sum over plots of concordance selector times staged panel call times plot CH4 flux: 4472 kg CH4 per year
[selected-result] Confirmed peatland CH4 emission over 24 plots at a per-unit agreement rate of 0.75 is 4472 kg CH4 per year.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: To falsify the no-issue verdict I assumed the issue was present and checked what the report would show: under a complemented panel, the agreement rate would be 6/24 = 0.25 and the emission sum (complement selector × complemented panel × flux, i.e., plots with observed=1 and staged panel=0) would be 205+198+187 = 590 kg. The report instead shows 0.75 and 4472 kg, which I reproduced exactly from the staged coding; the complement-derived quantities appear nowhere in the selected result. I also verified the variable flow line by line to confirm no aliasing routes panel_complement_values into the emission loop. The falsification attempt fails, supporting no demonstrated issue.
